methodology: T3 collaborative browser only. Separate tab_8, then tab_a. Snapshot before interaction; focused click first, guarded DOM click of the observed actual link when focused click failed. Beyond-homepage navigation used real internal links.

Runtime/font/CSS injected after navigation, extension storage/messaging mocked. Not an installed-extension/document_start test. Startup clone/parsing hooks could force fallback earlier in a true installation, so CSS-mode savings are conditional.

Two alternating samples of800ms scroll per route; each measurement compares observer baseline and automatic implementation in the same live document. Natural mutations can differ between samples. Zero-vs-zero means no measured steady-state gain.

All retained comparisons verify expected URL and3 font buffers. Original React interior comparisons predate explicit FontFace readiness checks; React homepage was revalidated with new helper and regular/bold font-ready true. All other pages use helper with FontFace validation true.

Later helper removes only duplicate Lexend FONT_FACE_RULE CSSOM entries to avoid data-font CSP conflicts while preloaded bundled binary FontFace objects supply actual glyphs; applied equally to both variants.

Two preview clients intermittently routed tab IDs to divergent page state, varying viewport1280x800 vs1536x960. Mismatches were discarded and navigation retried. This limits cross-site timing comparisons; paired samples remain within a single evaluate/document.
At least one interior screenshot visually reviewed per site. Protected code inspected on real articles. Screenshots were viewed through preview_snapshot image results; no image artifact retained.

Final cached /tmp/lexend-site-audit.js53320bytes includes scan-race and pause/resume-hook fixes. From MDN Specificity onward used scan-race fix; Astro Configuration and Vite use53320byte helper. Earlier settled-page comparisons remain valid but predate those race-specific changes.
findings: No auto-only visual or functional regression observed in sampled navigation/controls.
React homepage4 H2 news-card headings inherit Lexend under both observer and auto body-only modes. Explicit off/baseline/auto font comparison retained; pre-existing behavior, not a new regression.
Vue Introduction11px horizontal overflow reproduces identically with extension off, observer, and auto; not caused by new implementation.
Svelte begins CSS in after-load homepage test then switches to fallback on SPA Docs navigation with0 shadow roots, confirming conservative detector behavior affects real frameworks.

MDN uses28/37/121 open shadow roots across tested routes. Specificity includes protected syntax-highlighted code spans in the407 shadow-text denominator;45 samples styled does not mean remaining362 are missed ordinary text. Screenshot shows protected code readable.
Next.js uses1 open NEXT-ROUTE-ANNOUNCER shadow root across all routes; runtime remains shadow mode even though visible content is ordinary HTML.
